requirements.statement: For each frame (<iframe> or <frame>) that has a title attribute, the content of that attribute is relevant.

citations.quote: Pour chaque cadre (balise `<iframe>` ou `<frame>`) ayant un attribut `title`, le contenu de cet attribut est-il pertinent
Pour chaque cadre pourvu d’un attribut `title`, vérifier que son contenu est pertinent

routes.statement: The title lets the user know the nature of the content shown through the frame.

citations.quote: permettant de connaître la nature du contenu diffusé via le cadre

routes.statement: For a frame used only for technical operations, whose remote service gives no title or a non-relevant one, a generic mention is accepted.

citations.quote: Si ces cadres sont dépourvus de titre de cadre fournis par le service distant, ou si les titres de cadres sont jugés non pertinents, des mentions génériques peuvent être utilisées

exceptions.statement: A frame used only for technical operations is hidden from assistive technologies with aria-hidden="true", where that does not hinder its functioning; criterion 2.2 is then not applicable to it.

citations.quote: Si cela ne gêne pas le fonctionnement de ce type de cadre, il est possible de les rendre indisponibles aux technologies d’assistance en utilisant l’attribut WAI-ARIA aria-hidden="true". Dans ce cas le critère 2.1 et le critère 2.2 seront non applicables.

rationale.text: Relevance is judgment: whether a title tells the user what the frame shows cannot be decided by code. The glossary adds a second accepted form, a generic mention for purely technical frames, and the aria-hidden exception, and both turn on whether a frame is technical, which is also judgment. axe's frame-title-unique faults frames that share a title. That is a hint, not a failure: two frames may show the same kind of content, and the glossary's generic mentions for technical frames may legitimately repeat. It only looks at frames whose title is non-empty, so its scope is partial, and axe 4.14.0 itself marks its faults for review (reviewOnFail). The link is evidence only and the entry stays at none. One case looked mechanical, a title attribute that is empty, but the same defect could be read as a missing frame title under 2.1.1 rather than an irrelevant one here, so it is not claimed as a failure of this test. Applicability is judgment, because frames hidden under the exception leave the criterion not applicable only through a judgment. Needs is empty.

citations.quote: ce titre de cadre est-il pertinent
des mentions génériques peuvent être utilisées, par exemple title="contenus techniques Facebook".
